response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS o FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amt, ev.avg_amt - overall.o AS beat FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amt > overall.o) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amt AS average_amount, beat AS above_overall_average, avg_amt - (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) FROM above) AS gap_from_above_mean FROM above ORDER BY gap_from_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10
